description: CalFresh is California’s SNAP food-assistance program. Apply through BenefitsCal or your county social-services agency.
introduction: CalFresh is California’s SNAP food-assistance program. Apply through BenefitsCal or your county social-services agency.

sections.who: County staff assess household income and the program’s other rules. SSI/SSP recipients may also qualify; receiving SSI is not a reason to rule out CalFresh.
sections.get: Approved households receive food benefits on EBT for eligible purchases. The county decision identifies the amount and certification period.
sections.docs: Prepare household information, income and relevant housing or care expenses. Follow the county’s verification checklist and identify any records you cannot obtain.
sections.apply:
1. Start at BenefitsCal or contact your county office. CalFresh information and county assistance are available through 877-847-3663.

  2. Follow interview and verification notices. If you have little or no money and need food urgently, ask the county to assess expedited service.
sections.after: California publishes a three-day expedited route for eligible households and a normal decision period of 30 days after application. Read reporting, recertification and fair-hearing instructions.
sections.sources:
Application and program details: CalFresh and county contact, Rights, expedited service and reporting, GetCalFresh transition.
